query:
UPDATE searches s
JOIN niches n ON s.sourceNicheId = n.id
SET s.brainId = n.brainId
WHERE s.sourceNicheId IS NOT NULL
  AND s.brainId IS NULL
  AND n.brainId IS NOT NULL;
